name: app-glucose-monitoring-onboarding-screen-held-in-backlit-hand
title: Glucose Onboarding Screen in a Backlit Hand
whatItIs: A pale card with a soft blue glow behind a hand holding a phone whose onboarding screen shows 'Glucose Monitoring & Health Insights' and a photo of a glucose meter and finger prick, with a blue Get Started button.
whatItMeans: The blue glow and clear photo tell the health story at a glance, and the silhouette hand keeps focus on the screen.
techniques: Radial blue glow behind the device
Realistic photo as the onboarding illustration

vocabulary.definition: The main image on an app's welcome screen.
Light spreading outward from a centre point.
Small bars showing which onboarding page is active.
